description: We are building a smart decision tool for the "Field Shift" challenge, using NASA data (SMAP, POWER) to help farmers plan resilient crop rotation and soil management. Join us to turn raw satellite data into practical climate resilience!
summary:
The Problem: Farmers struggle to combine raw orbital datasets at field scale and interpret biophysical metrics in low-connectivity environments where WhatsApp is the main channel.

How Space2Soil Works: Space2Soil (space2soil.com) pairs a geospatial web app with a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and a WhatsApp AI bot. Users draw a field polygon, and the engine runs an auditable pipeline using real APIs:
- APIs & Data: NASA Earthdata HLS (30m COG + Fmask for NDVI, SAVI, EVI), NASA POWER API (daily radiation, Tmax/Tmin, humidity, wind, rain for FAO-56 ET0), GPM IMERG (precipitation), SMAP (soil moisture), and ISRIC SoilGrids/OpenLandMap (0-30cm texture, TAW/RAW).
- Data Validation (9 Gates): Every run validates WGS84 geometry/area (0.1-500k ha), cloud-free pixel support, climate window completeness, soil physics, Pareto trade-offs, and semantic report checks in fail-closed mode with a SHA-256 audit trail (blocking recommendations if data is missing or clouded).
- MCP & AI Bot: Our OAuth 2.1/token-authenticated MCP server (/api/mcp) exposes 9 agronomic tools to ChatGPT and our WhatsApp bot (OpenAI/Gemini + Evolution API). The bot processes text, audio, and crop photos, calls MCP tools by field name/ID to fetch persisted NASA evidence or trigger new analyses, and translates technical metrics into plain conversational guidance.
details:
The Problem

Farmers and agricultural technicians in Brazil face two main barriers when using Earth observation data:

1. The technical complexity of gathering, spatially clipping, and cross-referencing multiple orbital missions (optical, meteorological, radar/microwave, and soil maps) at the actual field scale.

2. The difficulty of interpreting raw biophysical indices in the field, where connectivity is limited and WhatsApp is the primary communication channel.

How Space2Soil Works

Space2Soil combines a geospatial web application (space2soil.com), an authenticated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and a multimodal WhatsApp AI Agronomist Bot to turn field polygons and NASA Earth observation data into auditable decisions and plain-language guidance.

APIs & Data Sources Integrated

- NASA Earthdata CMR & HLS COG (HLSS30 / HLSL30 v2.0 — 30m): Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs clipped to each field polygon, using Fmask cloud/shadow filtering to compute NDVI, SAVI, and EVI.

- NASA POWER API (power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/daily/point): Daily agroclimatology time series (ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, T2M, T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, RH2M, WS2M, PRECTOTCORR) for FAO-56 Penman-Monteith evapotranspiration (ET0) and water balance modeling.

- NASA GPM IMERG & NASA SMAP: Accumulated precipitation over 7-to-30-day windows and surface soil moisture (m³/m³).

- ISRIC SoilGrids v2.0 & OpenLandMap SoilDB (Fallback): 0–30 cm soil texture (clay, sand, silt percentages) and soil water retention parameters (TAW and RAW).

- Space2Soil MCP API (/api/mcp) & OAuth 2.1: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint authenticated per tenant via OAuth 2.1 or scoped MCP tokens.

- AI & Messaging APIs: OpenAI / Google Gemini APIs for reasoning, audio transcription (Whisper), and image interpretation, integrated with WhatsApp via the Evolution API.

Data Validation & Scientific Governance (9 Epistemic Gates)

Every analysis run validates input and orbital data across 9 deterministic verification gates before allowing an operational recommendation (operating in fail-closed mode whenever data is missing or clouded):

- Gates 0–1 (Geometry & Topology): Validates closed WGS84 (EPSG:4326) polygons and field area bounds (0.1 to 500,000 ha).

- Gate 2 (Spectral Quality): Validates cloud- and shadow-free pixel fraction (Fmask) at field-resolving scale (FIELD_SUPPORTED / FIELD_MASKED).

- Gate 3 (Water Balance): Validates completeness of the NASA POWER daily climate window and non-hypothetical soil parameters for FAO-56 depletion (Dr) and stress (Ks) calculations.

- Gates 4–6 (Anti-Hallucination & Lineage): Enforces evidence-backed claims (INV-001), multi-objective Pareto scenario evaluation (soil resilience, water conservation, climate risk — without unverified financial projections), and semantic report verification (INV-003) persisted with a SHA-256 cryptographic lineage.

- Gates 7–8 (Field Calibration & Crop Transition): Checks in-situ rain gauge/soil sensor calibration for operational promotion and agroecological crop succession compatibility.

MCP Server & Multimodal AI Bot Usage

- 9 Exposed MCP Tools: Through /api/mcp, external AI clients (such as ChatGPT) and our internal bot securely call listar_fazendas_e_talhoes, consultar_previsao_chuva, consultar_balanco_hidrico, consultar_saude_vegetativa, consultar_laudo_analise, consultar_fisica_solo, consultar_auditoria_gates, consultar_criterios_analise, and executar_analise_talhao (write action requiring explicit user confirmation and idempotency keys).

- WhatsApp AI Bot: Receives text messages, voice notes (transcribed automatically), and field photos, resolves the producer's field by name or ID, queries real persisted NASA/soil evidence via MCP in the background, and replies in natural conversational Portuguese — translating technical metrics (NDVI, ET0, water deficit, rainfall) into clear day-to-day guidance while only displaying raw technical numbers when explicitly requested.
dataRefs: NASA HLS (Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 v2.0 - 30m)
